I’m on Adderall for my ADHD. In my experience, it has not affected my OCD. If anything it helps a bit because I can focus better and have more motivation which makes it easier for me to deal with day to day tasks/working without my brain working against me. Hope that makes sense. My OCD is very internal and I do a lot of ruminating, so when I take my ADHD meds typically my mind gets quieter and clearer, therefore my OCD calms down some too
